items.stem: Which of the following best describes the condition for two ratios to be proportional?
In the passage, the ratio of glasses of lemonade to spoons of sugar is 6 : 10. If 18 glasses of lemonade are to be made, how many spoons of sugar are needed to maintain the same sweetness?
In the passage, the ratio of the width to height of image A is 60 : 40. If the width of image A is multiplied by 3, what should be the new height to maintain proportionality?
What is the simplest form of the ratio 60 : 40?
If the ratio of width to height of an image is 60 : 40, and the width is reduced to 30 mm, what should be the new height to maintain proportionality?
What is the ratio of Neelima's age to her mother's age when Neelima is 3 years old?
If the ratio of coffee decoction to milk in regular filter coffee is 15 : 35, and Manjunath wants to make a stronger coffee, which of the following ratios would he most likely use?
In a school, the ratio of teachers to students is 5 : 170. If the school has 120 students, what would be the number of teachers required to maintain the same ratio?
In the passage, it is stated that when Neelima is 3 years old, her mother's age is 10 times her age. If Neelima's age is x, what is the expression that represents her mother's age in terms of x?
What is the term used for the method of finding the fourth proportional by multiplying the means and the extremes?

Manjunath mixes 15 mL of coffee decoction with 35 mL of milk to make regular filter coffee. He then wants to make a stronger coffee by increasing the ratio of coffee to milk. If he uses 20 mL of coffee, how much milk should he add to maintain a stronger ratio than regular coffee?
A car travels 90 km in 150 minutes. What distance will it cover in 4 hours if it continues at the same speed?
A small farmer in Himachal Pradesh sells 200 g of tea for ₹200. A large estate in Meghalaya sells 1 kg of tea for ₹800. Are the weight-to-price ratios proportional?
A mason needs 1450 bricks to build a 10-foot wall. How many bricks would he need to build a wall that is 15 feet long?
Puneeth’s father travels from Lucknow to Kanpur at 50 km/h in 2 hours. If he travels at 75 km/h, how long will it take him? Why can't this be solved using the Rule of Three?
If 42 counters are shared in the ratio 4 : 3, how many counters does each person get?
A mixture of 40 kg has sand and cement in the ratio 3 : 1. How much cement should be added to make the ratio 5 : 2?
What is the ratio of grey bricks to coloured bricks in the pattern shown in the passage?
A farmer needs to apply 10 tonnes of cow manure for 1 acre of land. If the size of his plot is 200 ft by 500 ft, how much cow manure should he buy?
A cupro-nickel coin has a mass of 7.74 grams, with copper and nickel in a 3:1 ratio. If copper costs ₹906 per kg and nickel costs ₹1,341 per kg, what is the total cost of the metals in the coin?

A farmer plans to grow tomatoes in a plot of 200 ft by 500 ft. He needs 10 tonnes of manure per acre. If 1 acre = 43,560 sq ft, how much manure should he buy, and what is the approximate value in tonnes?
The cost of 1 acre of land is ₹15,00,000. What is the cost of 2,400 square feet of the same land?
What is the ratio of grey bricks to coloured bricks in a block of the pattern shown in the passage?
What is the simplest form of the ratio 16:12 as shown in the passage?
If the Earth travels 940 million km in a year, how many km does it travel in a week?
If acid and water are mixed in the ratio 1:5 to make a solution, how much acid is in 240 mL of the solution?
How many bricks are required to build a wall of 108 ft if 1450 bricks are needed for a 10 ft wall?
If the area of Delhi is 1,484 sq. km and the area of Mumbai is 550 sq. km, and the population of Delhi is 30 million and that of Mumbai is 20 million, which city is more crowded?
One acre of land costs ₹15,00,000. What is the cost of 2,400 square feet of the same land?

A tractor can plough the same area of a field 4 times faster than a pair of oxen. A farmer wants to plough his 20-acre field. A pair of oxen takes 6 hours to plough an acre of land. How much time would it take if the farmer used a tractor instead?
A crane of height 155 cm has its neck and the rest of its body in the ratio 4 : 6. If your neck and the rest of your body also had this ratio, how tall would your neck be?
If a : b :: c : d, then which of the following is always true?
What is the simplest form of the ratio of orange juice to apple juice if Anagh mixes 600 mL of orange juice with 900 mL of apple juice?
If 12 counters are shared in the ratio 3 : 1, how many counters does each person get?
A tap fills a 500 mL mug in 15 seconds. How long does it take to fill a 10-litre bucket?
A pair of oxen takes 6 hours to plough 1 acre of land. A tractor is 4 times faster. How long does it take the tractor to plough 20 acres?
What is the ratio of orange juice to apple juice if Anagh mixes 600 mL of orange juice with 900 mL of apple juice?
If 12 counters are shared between two people in the ratio 3 : 1, how many counters does each person get?
What is the simplest form of the ratio 6 : 6?
What is the simplified form of the ratio 14 : 21?
If the ratio of the lengths of two walls is 60 : 40, and the length of the second wall is increased to 60 ft, what should be the length of the first wall to maintain the same proportion?
